blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.
blocks.zh: 分化语言模型平行地重建了被遮住的活符,为自发生成提供了一种替代. 然而,他们的变形器骨干通常通过单一的残余流携带可见证据并不断演化出被掩盖的预测. 我们为被遮住的传播模型配备了多条残留流,这些流流通过深度和适应性途径在它们之间持续存在,然后调查它们如何支持这些互补作用。 在前期训练任务方面,两道溪流在验证数据上减少了5.71%的重建迷惑度,与标准的剩余连接相比,整个外部公司平均减少了5.13%. 我们观察到,如果没有预先确定的角色,可见和被遮掩的位置就会学习出不同的路由规律. 原因干预表明,这种区别组织着读写路由,而具体符号的写作强度在每个角色中仍然很重要. 以这些调查结果为指导,一个受过角色条件化路线训练的模型恢复了增加第二流的验证收益的一半. 国家干预解释了额外流动的好处:它保留了早期的象征性表示,供以后再使用,而证据则在被遮蔽的位置上积累。 这一机制在更大的模型规模下重复出现,表明持久性流如何在改进预测的同时支持环境保护。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion language models have recently emerged as an alternative to autoregressive language modeling ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Rather than generating text token by token, they predict many missing positions in parallel and refine uncertain predictions over successive steps. Reconstruction can use context from both sides, supporting flexible generation orders and naturally accommodating text infilling.
blocks.zh: 传播语言模型最近作为自动递归语言模型的替代品出现(Austin等人,2021年;Hoogeboom等人,2021年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Nie等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年)。 它们不是象征性地产生文字符号,而是平行地预测许多缺失的位置,并改进对连续步骤的不确定预测。 重建可以使用双方的上下文,支持灵活的生成命令,并自然地容纳文本填充.

blocks.en: The two generation schemes also differ in what they require of each token position. Under next-token training, autoregressive positions share a largely uniform prediction task: each uses its prefix to predict the following token. Masked diffusion combines two complementary roles within the same denoising pass. Visible positions carry observed tokens that supply evidence for reconstruction, while masked positions must gather contextual information to form and refine predictions. These roles coexist in every partially corrupted sequence, so the backbone must accommodate observed evidence and evolving predictions across positions and through depth.
blocks.zh: 两代人计划对每个象征性职位的要求也不同。 在邻接式训练下,自旋式位置分担了大致一致的预测任务:每个位置都使用它的前缀来预测以下符号. 假面传播将同一假面传中的两个互补作用结合在一起. 可见的姿势带有为重建提供证据的被观察到的标志,而蒙蔽的姿势则必须收集背景信息以形成和完善预测。 这些角色在每一个部分腐败的序列中并存,因此骨干必须适应观测到的证据和跨越位置和经过深度的不断发展的预测.

blocks.en: Despite these different roles, most masked diffusion models inherit the standard Transformer residual pathway. Attention and MLP branches can respond to the corruption mask, but at each position they read from and write to a single persistent state. We ask whether learned routes through depth can better support these complementary roles.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些不同的角色,大多数蒙面扩散模型都继承了标准变形器残余路径. 注意和MLP分支可以应对腐败面具,但在每一个位置,它们读到并写到一个单一的持久状态. 我们问,通过深入了解的途径是否能够更好地支持这些互补作用。

blocks.en: Work beyond text diffusion shows that residual pathways can be made learnable. ReZero and DenseFormer regulate updates or combine information across depth, while Hyper-Connections introduce multiple persistent streams with learned read, mixing, and write patterns ( Bachlechner et al., 2021 ; Pagliardini et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) . For masked diffusion, this flexibility offers a way to preserve useful evidence while refining predictions, with routing that can adapt to the different roles of visible and masked positions.
blocks.zh: 文本传播以外的工作表明,剩余路径是可以学习的。 ReZero和DenseFormer规范更新或综合跨深度信息,而Hyper-Connections则引入了多个持久性溪流,具有学习的读,混,写模式(Bachlechner等人,2021年;Pagliardini等人,2017年). 2024; 朱等, 2025; 谢等, 2025). 对于蒙面扩散,这种灵活性提供了一种在完善预测的同时保存有用证据的方法,其路径可以适应可见和蒙面位置的不同作用.

blocks.en: We first introduce token-conditioned update strength within a single residual stream. This improves diffusion modeling and provides a learned baseline for evaluating the benefit of multiple persistent states. Two streams capture most of the further gain, so we focus on how the model uses this added capacity. Causal interventions show that the visible/masked distinction organizes read and write-destination routing, while token-specific write volume remains important within each role.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在单一的残余流中 引入标语条件更新强度 这改进了传播模式,并为评价多种持久性状态的好处提供了学习的基线。 两条溪流捕捉了大部分进一步的收益,因此我们专注于模型如何使用这个新增的能力. 原因干预表明,可见/混杂的区别组织着读写目的地的路由,而具体符号的写字量在每个角色中仍然很重要.

blocks.en: Stream-state interventions show how the extra state supports denoising: it keeps early information available while the model gathers evidence for masked predictions. One stream retains position-specific states formed in early blocks through middle depth, as visible-source influence accumulates at masked targets. Late layers then increase reading from this stream and reuse the retained visible state. This preservation–transfer–reuse sequence recurs at a larger model scale, while preservation followed by renewed late reading also extends across stream counts. These findings motivate residual pathways that adapt to token roles and coordinate evidence preservation with prediction refinement.
blocks.zh: 流态干预显示额外状态如何支持去诺:它保留早期信息可用,而模型则为蒙蔽的预测收集证据. 一流保留在早期块中通过中深度形成的位置特定状态,因为可见源影响在被遮蔽的目标上积累. 后层再从此流增加读取,再利用保留可见状态. 这种保存-转移-再使用序列在更大的模型尺度上重复出现,而保存之后的更新的晚读也跨流数. 这些结论激励了适应象征性作用的剩余路径,并协调证据保存和完善预测。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • Residual expansion. We establish the benefits of learned residual transport in masked diffusion. Two persistent streams capture 86.6% of the largest additional validation-CE gain beyond learned single-stream control in the stream-count sweep and achieve the largest mean masked-reconstruction perplexity reduction across four external corpora. • Role specialization. We separate write destination from write volume and show through controlled interventions that masked/visible roles organize read and write-destination routing, while token-specific write volume matters for visible evidence early and masked predictions late. These findings also guide a role-factorized interface trained from scratch. • State reuse. We uncover a preservation–transfer–reuse mechanism linking persistent states to denoising computation: one stream preserves early position-specific states through middle depth while visible-source influence accumulates at masked targets, and late layers reuse the retained visible state. Its functional stages recur at a larger model scale. Models with two, three, and four streams also preserve early states and resume reading them in late layers.
blocks.zh: • 剩余扩展。 我们确定在蒙面扩散中学会的残余运输的好处。 两条持久性的溪流捕捉到86.6%最大的额外验证-CE增益,超出了学得的单流控制在溪流计扫荡中,并实现了四个外部公司中最大的平均面罩重建偏差减少. • 角色专业化。 我们通过隐蔽/隐蔽角色组织读写目的地路由的控制性干预,将写出目的地与写出音量分开,同时将特定符号写出音量的事项用于早期可见和隐蔽的预测. 这些结论还指导了一个从零开始培训的角色要素界面。 • 国家再利用。 我们发现了一种将持久性状态与去诺化计算联系在一起的保存-转移-再利用机制:一流流通过中深度保留了早期位置特定状态,而可见源影响则在隐蔽的目标上积累,而后层则重新使用所保留的可见状态。 它的功能阶段以更大的模型规模重现. 具有二,三,四条流的模型也保留了早期的状态,并在后层恢复阅读.

Two persistent streams capture 86.6% of the largest additional validation-CE gain beyond learned single-stream control in the stream-count sweep and achieve the largest mean masked-reconstruction perplexity reduction across four external corpora.

We separate write destination from write volume and show through controlled interventions that masked/visible roles organize read and write-destination routing, while token-specific write volume matters for visible evidence early and masked predictions late. These findings also guide a role-factorized interface trained from scratch.

We uncover a preservation–transfer–reuse mechanism linking persistent states to denoising computation: one stream preserves early position-specific states through middle depth while visible-source influence accumulates at masked targets, and late layers reuse the retained visible state. Its functional stages recur at a larger model scale. Models with two, three, and four streams also preserve early states and resume reading them in late layers.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Discrete diffusion extends corruption and denoising to categorical sequences ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Lou et al., 2024 ) . Masked diffusion develops this approach for language modeling, training models to reconstruct missing tokens from partially observed sequences ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) . Recent systems demonstrate progress in training objectives, decoding, and scale ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . These advances establish denoising as a practical alternative to autoregressive generation, while generally retaining the standard Transformer residual pathway. We investigate this architectural choice: whether multiple persistent states and learned routes through depth can better support the computation performed within a denoising pass.
blocks.zh: 分散传播将腐败和诽谤扩展到绝对序列(Austin等人,2021年;Hoogeboom等人,2021年;Lou等人,2024年)。 蒙面传播为语言建模开发了这种方法,培训模型从部分观测到的序列中重建缺失的代号(Sahoo等人,2024年). 最近的系统显示,在培训目标、编码和规模方面取得了进展(Nie等人,2025年;Ye等人,2025年)。 这些进展将淡化作为自动递减生成的一种实际替代办法,同时一般保留标准的变形器残余路径。 我们调查了这种建筑选择:通过深度的多个持续状态和学习的路线是否能够更好地支持在解密通道内进行的计算。

blocks.en: Recent work shows that token mask state affects both context processing and internal representations. Appended mask tokens can act as distractors and impair context comprehension ( Piskorz et al., 2026 ) . Masked and unmasked positions exhibit different activation distributions, motivating state-specific transformations for quantization ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . Reusing hidden states across denoising steps also benefits from distinguishing unchanged, still-masked, and newly revealed tokens ( Miele et al., 2026 ) . These findings motivate treating mask state as a computational variable. We ask how the complementary roles of visible evidence and masked predictions organize the processing, preservation, and reuse of information through network depth.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作显示,象征面具状态既影响上下文处理,也影响内部表现. 附加的口罩符可以起到分散注意力和损害上下文理解的作用(Piskorz等人,2026年). 蒙面和未蒙面的姿势显示出不同的激活分布,激发了具体国家的转型,以便量化(Yan等人,2026年)。 重新使用隐蔽的状态,跨越消音步骤,也有利于区分未变的、仍装模作样的和新公布的代币(Miele等人,2026年)。 这些发现促使人们将遮罩状态视为一个计算变量。 我们询问,可见证据和蒙蔽预测的互补作用如何通过网络深度组织信息处理、保存和再利用。

blocks.en: Residual redesigns offer forms of control over information flow. ReZero introduces zero-initialized learnable gates on residual branches ( Bachlechner et al., 2021 ) , while DeepNorm combines residual scaling with depth-dependent initialization ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . DenseFormer learns weighted combinations of current and earlier representations ( Pagliardini et al., 2024 ) , while Attention Residuals aggregates representations across depth using input-dependent softmax attention ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) . They regulate updates or retrieve information from layer history. In masked diffusion, visible positions provide evidence, whereas masked positions construct predictions from it. This distinction motivates asking whether residual routing should adapt to a token’s role and current state, beyond update scaling and retrieval from layer history.
blocks.zh: 残余的重新设计提供了对信息流动的控制形式。 ReZero在残留分支上引入零初始化可学习门(Baghlechner等人,2021年),而DeepNorm将残留缩放与深度依赖初始化相结合(Wang等人,2024年). DenseFormer学习了当前和早期表达的加权组合(Pagliardini等人,2024年),而Reception Receptions则利用依赖输入的软max关注(Kimi Team,2026年)将表达的跨深度汇总. 它们规范更新或从层历史中检索信息. 在蒙面扩散中,可见位置提供证据,而蒙面位置则从中构建预测. 这种区别促使人们问,除了更新规模和从层历史中检索之外,剩余路径是否应该适应一个标志的作用和现状。

blocks.en: Hyper-Connections provide an interface through parallel streams and learned maps governing how sublayers read, mix, and update them, with token-dependent connection weights in the dynamic variant ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . mHC constrains mixing toward doubly stochastic matrices via Sinkhorn–Knopp normalization ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , while mHC-lite constructs them exactly as convex combinations of permutation matrices, avoiding iterative normalization ( Yang and Gao, 2026 ) . We extend this interface to text diffusion, establishing its pretraining benefits and revealing how denoising organizes residual information flow without prescribed routes for masked or visible positions.
blocks.zh: Hyper-Connections通过并行流提供界面,并学习地图,指导子层如何读取,混合,更新,在动态变体中具有依赖符号的连接权重(Zhu等人,2025年). mHC通过Sinkhorn-Knopp正常化(Xie 等人,2025年)限制混合向双层结构基质的组合,而mHC-lite则将它们完全构建为长质基质的对流组合,避免了迭代正常化(Yang和Gao,2026年). 我们把这一接口扩大到文本的传播,确立其预先培训的好处,并揭示在未规定遮盖或可见位置的路线的情况下,解密如何组织剩余信息流动。

blocks.en: Analyses of autoregressive HC and mHC models report asymmetric stream reliance, concentrated read/write routing, and near-identity mixing ( Peng et al., 2026 ; Alimaskina et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . These findings motivate going beyond aggregate performance to understand how learned interfaces use the additional streams. We study corruption-role-conditioned routing, separate write destination from volume, and trace source-dependent prediction recovery alongside the preservation of early states.
blocks.zh: 对自递性HC和mHC模型的分析报告不对称流依赖,集中读/写路由,以及近身份混合(彭等人,2026年;阿里马斯金娜等人,2026年;赵等人,2026年). 这些结果激励人们超越总体业绩,了解学到的界面如何利用额外的流程。 我们研究有腐败条件的路径, 将书写目的地与体积分开,

blocks.en: We analyze the HC-family post-mapping ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Yang and Gao, 2026 ) via normalized write destination and overall write strength, enabling separate interventions on these two coordinates. Our results show this distinction matters: masked versus visible role largely organizes reading and write destination, while write volume is most sensitive to within-role averaging. Replacing token-dependent write volume also degrades autoregressive models (Appendix E.1 ), suggesting that token-dependent update strength is a general component of learned residual transport.
blocks.zh: 我们通过正常的书写目的地和整体书写强度来分析HC-家族图谱后(Zhu等人,2025年;谢等人,2025年;杨和高,2026年),使得能够分别对这两个坐标进行干涉. 我们的结果显示了这种区别:蒙面角色与可见角色主要组织读写目的地,而写音量对内在作用平均最敏感. 取代依赖令牌的书写量也会降解自递式模型(Appendix E.1 ),说明依赖令牌的更新强度是学习到的残余运输的一般组成部分.

blocks.en: Takeaway. The residual interface has four controls: reading selects what a sublayer uses, mixing redistributes existing states across streams, write destination allocates the new update, and write volume controls its overall strength.
blocks.zh: 外卖 剩余接口有四个控制:读取一个子层使用什么,混合在流间重新分配现有状态,写目的地分配新的更新,写量控制其整体强度.

blocks.en: 4 How Many Residual Streams Does Diffusion Need?
blocks.zh: 4 有多少残留流需要扩散?

blocks.en: Before analyzing how diffusion uses residual streams, we ask how many are useful. We compare mHC-lite variants ( n = 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 n=1,2,3,4 ) with a standard-residual baseline using a 16-block Qwen-style backbone ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , approximately 337M parameters, and the Dream tokenizer ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . All models are trained on the same ordered 3.5B tokens from FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) , with the backbone, token budget, and learning-rate schedule held fixed. The learned n = 1 n=1 interface provides token-dependent update strength, while wider variants add routing across persistent streams. This width sweep guides the choice of model for the mechanistic analysis. Full training and evaluation details appear in Appendices A and B .
blocks.zh: 在分析扩散如何使用残余流之前,我们问有多少是有用的。 我们比较mHC-lite变体(n = 1, 2, 3, 4 n = 1, 2, 3, 4)与标准剩余基线,使用16块的Quen型骨干(Quen Team, 2024),参数约为337M,以及Dream orderiser(Ye et al., 2025). 所有型号都以FineWeb-Edu(Penedo等人,2024年)订购的相同3.5B令牌进行训练,骨干,象征性预算,学习率时间表固定不变. 学习的n=1n=1接口提供了依赖符号的更新强度,而更广泛的变体则增加了跨持久流的路由. 这种宽度扫码指导了机械分析模型的选择. 完整的培训和评价细节载于附录A和B。

blocks.en: Even one learned stream improves over the standard residual, reducing validation reconstruction perplexity by 2.50 % 2.50\% . Two streams bring this reduction to 5.71 % 5.71\% , capturing 86.6 % 86.6\% of the best additional CE gain beyond learned n = 1 n=1 (Figure 2 ). Adding a third or fourth stream yields only a further 0.52 % 0.52\% or 0.45 % 0.45\% reduction in perplexity relative to n = 2 n=2 . Since most of the benefit is already achieved with two streams, we use n = 2 n=2 for the mechanistic analysis. At 1B, two streams reduce validation reconstruction perplexity by 3.47 % 3.47\% versus the matched standard residual (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 甚至一个学得的溪流在标准残基上也有所改善,将验证重建的模糊度降低了2.50%2.50%。 两条溪流使这一减少达到5.71%的5.71\%,捕获了86.6%的86.6\%在所学n=1n=1(图2)。 加上第三或第四流的产量,相对于n = 2 n = 2, 更进一步减少0.52% 0.52\%或0.45% 0.45\%。 由于大部分好处已经用两个流实现,我们用n=2n=2来进行机械分析. 1B时,两条流将验证重建的迷惑度比对应的标准残值(附录一)减少了3.47%的3.47%.

blocks.en: To test whether the benefit of two streams extends beyond FineWeb-Edu, we evaluate all checkpoints on OpenWebText, WikiText-103, LAMBADA, and C4 using identical examples and masks at three corruption levels. All multi-stream variants improve over the standard-residual baseline on every corpus. Although wider models lead on individual corpora, n = 2 n=2 achieves the largest mean perplexity reduction, at 5.13 % 5.13\% (Table 1 ). Full details and paired bootstrap intervals appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了检验两条溪流的好处是否超越FineWeb-Edu,我们评价OpenWebText、Wikitext-103、LAMBADA和C4上的所有检查站, 所有多流变体都比每个体的标准剩余基线有所改善。 尽管更宽的模型在个体公司身上领先,n = 2 n = 2 实现了最大的平均复杂度降低,为5.13% 5.13\%(表1). 附录B载有全部细节和配对靴子间隔。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Two streams capture most of the in-domain benefit of residual expansion and achieve the strongest mean transfer across four corpora. We therefore use n = 2 n=2 to trace how denoising uses the learned interface.
blocks.zh: 外卖 两条溪流捕捉了剩余扩张的大部分域内收益,实现了四股股股的最强平均转移. 因此,我们使用 n = 2 n = 2 来追踪如何使用学到的界面进行调试.

blocks.en: 5 The Corruption Mask Organizes Residual Routing
blocks.zh: 5 腐败面具组织残余路线

blocks.en: The second stream improves performance beyond token-dependent update strength, suggesting that routing across persistent states also matters. We therefore ask what guides this routing. In masked diffusion, the corruption mask distinguishes positions that provide observed evidence from those that predict missing content. Our interventions test which routing decisions follow this role distinction and which require finer token-specific information.
blocks.zh: 第二流改善了业绩,超越了依赖符号的更新强度,表明跨越持久性州的路由也很重要。 因此,我们询问这条路线的走向。 在隐蔽传播中,腐败面具将提供观察到的证据的立场与预测缺失内容的立场区分开来. 我们的干预措施检验了哪些决定遵循这一作用的区别,哪些要求更具体地提供具体的信息。

blocks.en: We study the n = 2 n=2 model at t = 0.5 t=0.5 with 50% masking, where both token roles are well represented. Each intervention targets one control – read, mixing, write destination, or write volume – throughout the network. The remaining controls are computed normally from the intervened states. At each attention and MLP interface, we test three replacements: a global mean shared by all tokens, separate role means for masked and visible tokens, and a role swap that exchanges these two means. We also test joint replacement of all four controls. Calibration uses sequences disjoint from evaluation, and roles are identified from the corrupted input. Appendix A specifies how stream-wise write gains are reconstructed for destination, volume, and joint interventions.
blocks.zh: 我们研究n = 2 n = 2 型号在 t = 0.5 t = 0.5 带有50%的面具,其中两个象征角色都有很好的代表. 每一次干预都针对整个网络的一个控制(读、混、写目的地或写体积). 其余的控制通常从干预国计算。 在每次注意和MLP接口上,我们测试三种替换:一种是所有符牌共享的全球平均值,一种是蒙面和可见符牌的单独角色手段,另一种是交换这两种手段的角色交换. 我们还试验联合更换所有四个控制器。 校准使用与评价脱节的序列,角色从腐朽的输入中识别出来. 附 录 A具体说明如何为目的地、数量和联合干预重建流式写作收益。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Masked and visible tokens use distinct residual routes. Role-conditioned means remove most degradation from global averaging of read and write destination. Swapping either setting performs worse than the standard residual. A shared mixer nearly preserves performance, while write volume retains substantial within-role dependence. Lower masked-target CE is better. Individual rows replace one control, leaving the others state-dependent; the joint row replaces all four. Estimates and confidence intervals appear in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 图3:蒙面和醒目的标志使用不同的残余路线。 角色条件化意味着将大多数降解从全球平均读写目的地中移除。 任意设定都比标准残留值差。 共享混音器几乎保留了性能,而写音量则保留了作用内的大量依赖. 较低的蒙面目标CE更好. 单行取代一个控件,让其他控件依赖国家;联合行取代全部四个控件. 估计和置信间隔见附录D。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that collapsing read/write destination to one mean substantially degrades performance. Separate means for masked and visible positions largely remove this degradation. For read and write destination, role-conditioned means remove 95.7% and 98.6% of the CE increase caused by global averaging, respectively, measured relative to the intact model.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,读/写目的地倒数1意味着性能大幅下降。 蒙面和可见位置的单独手段基本上消除了这种退化。 对读写目的地而言,角色条件化意味着,相对于完好模型,分别消除全球平均值造成的95.7%和98.6%的CE增长。

blocks.en: This identifies the corruption mask as a major organizing factor for read and write-destination routing. Swapping the two role means sharply degrades denoising, showing that these routes are functionally specialized and must remain matched to token role. Mixing behaves differently: using a single mean at each interface causes little degradation, indicating that a largely shared mixing configuration supports denoising. The benefit of role-conditioned read and write-destination means recurs in the larger 1B model (Appendix I.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这把腐败面具确定为读写定位路由的一个主要组织因素. 撕毁这两个角色意味着大幅度地降级,表明这些路线在功能上是专门化的,必须保持与象征性角色相匹配. 混合行为不同:在每个接口使用一个单一的平均值不会造成多少降解,表明一个基本共享的混合配置支持去诺化. 角色附加条件的读写定位的好处意味着在更大的1B模型(附录I.3 )中重复出现.

blocks.en: Write volume remains sensitive even to role-conditioned averaging, showing that token-specific update strength matters within each role. Applying role means to all four controls at once is substantially more disruptive than replacing any one individually: joint replacement raises CE by 1.6453 1.6453 (Appendix D ). We therefore test role-conditioned routing in a factorized interface trained from scratch, allowing its controls to adapt together.
blocks.zh: 书写体积仍然敏感,甚至对角色条件的平均值也敏感,表明每个角色中特定标志性的更新强度很重要。 将作用同时应用到所有四种控制上,比单独替换任何一种要具有更大的破坏性:联合替换使CE增加1.6453 1.6453(附录D)。 因此,我们在从零开始训练的模块化接口中测试有作用条件的路径,使其控制能够一起适应。

blocks.en: Our role-factorized two-stream model, termed Factorized Residual Routing (FRR), learns separate read and write-destination settings for masked and visible tokens at each attention and MLP interface. Write volume remains token-dependent, while stream mixing is fixed to the identity. Write gains factorize into volume and normalized destination, retaining the full router’s total write-volume range. The backbone, data order, corruption masks, and optimization schedule match the other learned-interface models (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们的角色构思双流模式,称为“因数化残余线程”(FRR),在每次注意力和MLP接口中,为蒙面和可见的符号学习单独的读写定位设置。 写音量仍然依赖符号,而流混合则固定在身份上. 写入收益计入数量和正常目的地,保留全部路由器的总写量范围。 骨干,数据顺序,腐败面具,优化时间表与其他学习界面模型(附录C)相匹配.

blocks.en: FRR reaches a validation CE of 3.5634 3.5634 , improving over learned n = 1 n=1 ( 3.5802 3.5802 ) and recovering 50.2 % 50.2\% of the gain achieved by full n = 2 n=2 ( 3.5467 3.5467 ). Thus, the masked/visible distinction can guide the learning of useful read and write routes: even with identity mixing, role-conditioned routes and token-dependent write strength allow the model to benefit from a second persistent state. Full n = 2 n=2 provides a further 0.0167 0.0167 CE improvement.
blocks.zh: FRR达到了3.5634 3.5634 的验证CE,比所学n = 1 n = 1 (3.5802 3.5802 )有所改进,并收回了全n = 2 n = 2 (3.5467 3.5467 ) 实现的收益的50.2% 50.2\%. 因此,蒙蔽/可见的区分可以指导学习有用的读写路由:即使身份混杂,角色条件化的路由和信使依赖的书写强度,使模型能够从第二个持续状态中受益. 完全n = 2 n = 2 提供了进一步的0.0167 0.0167 CE改进.

blocks.en: Takeaway. The masked/visible distinction guides read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains consequential within each role. FRR turns this division into a trained architecture that recovers half the gain from a second stream.
blocks.zh: 外卖 蒙面/可见的区别指南读写路由,而符号特定写作强度在每一个角色中仍然产生结果. FRR将这个师变成训练有素的建筑,从第二流中回收一半的收益.

blocks.en: 6 Write Volume Matters for Visible Tokens Early and Masked Tokens Late
blocks.zh: 6 写入可辨识的托肯斯早期和蒙面托肯斯晚期的卷件事项

blocks.en: Masked/visible role organizes read and write-destination routing, while write volume carries functionally important variation within each role. Tokens with the same role can follow similar routes while receiving updates of different strength. At t = 0.5 t=0.5 , replacing write volume with its masked/visible mean increases CE by 0.200 0.200 , compared with 0.041 0.041 for read, 0.017 0.017 for write destination, and 0.006 0.006 for mixing. We therefore ask whether denoising depends on matching each volume to the token state that produced it, and how this dependence changes across depth and corruption levels.
blocks.zh: 蒙面/隐形角色组织读写定位路由,而写音量则在每个角色内部带有功能上重要的变化. 具有相同角色的托肯可以遵循类似的路线,同时接收不同强度的更新. 在 t = 0.5 t = 0.5 时,用其遮盖/可见的平均值取代书写体积,使CE 增加了 0.200 0.200 ,而读数为 0.041 0.041 ,写数目的地为 0.017 0.017 ,混合点为 0.006 0.006 . 因此,我们问道,消毒是否取决于将每一卷与产生它的象征性状态相匹配,以及这种依赖如何在深度和腐败程度之间发生改变。

blocks.en: We first test whether each volume must remain attached to the token state that produced it. A role-mean replacement assigns the calibrated mean for the token’s role and interface wherever the proportional replacement satisfies the gain bounds, removing within-role variation at those positions. A within-role shuffle exchanges current volumes between random disjoint pairs of same-role positions within each sequence and interface. An exchange is applied only when both directions satisfy the gain bounds, preserving the exact set of volume values within the group. Both interventions preserve each affected token’s current normalized write destination. The reconstruction and acceptance rules are specified in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试每个音量是否必须一直附着在产生它的符号状态上. 如果比例替代满足了收益限度,那么角色替代就指定了符号角色和界面的校准平均值,消除这些位置上作用内的变化。 一个内作用洗涤器在每一个序列和接口中任意脱节的对同作用位置之间交换流量. 只有在两个方向都满足增益界限时,才适用交换,保留组内准确的量值集. 这两次干预都保留了每个受影响的标志目前正常的书写目的地。 重建和验收规则见附录A。

blocks.en: We then locate this dependence through depth by applying the role-mean replacement to one block at a time. Finally, we repeat the full-network replacement across corruption levels to determine when token-specific volume is most useful. Read and mixing remain dynamic; calibration uses disjoint sequences, and effects are measured by the increase in masked-target CE.
blocks.zh: 然后我们通过一次将角色的替代应用到一个街区,通过深度确定这种依赖性。 最后,我们重复整个网络在腐败层面的更换,以确定具体标志的数量何时最有用。 读取和混合保持动态;校准使用脱节序列,效果通过遮蔽目标CE的增加来测量.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : The functional role of token-specific write volume shifts through depth. (a) At t = 0.5 t=0.5 , within-role shuffling is more damaging than role-mean replacement while preserving the current volume multiset within each sequence and role at every intervened interface.
(b) Single-block interventions reveal an early-visible / late-masked sensitivity profile; effects use separate zero-anchored axes.
(c) Sensitivity to within-role volume variation decreases near full masking.
Error bars and bands show paired 95% sequence-bootstrap intervals; n = 1,024 n=1{,}024 in (a–b) and 128 per corruption level in (c).

图4:特定符号写音量通过深度变化的功能作用. (a) 在t = 0.5 t = 0.5 时,作用内的洗牌比角色平均替换更具破坏力,同时在每个介入的界面中保留每个序列和角色中的现有容积多集。

blocks.en: Within-role shuffling is more damaging than role-mean replacement for both roles (Figure 4 a). For masked positions, shuffling increases CE by 0.132 0.132 , compared with 0.068 0.068 under averaging; for visible positions, the corresponding increases are 0.294 0.294 and 0.124 0.124 . Accepted exchanges retain the original write strengths but assign them to different tokens of the same role. The CE increase under this distribution-preserving exchange establishes the functional importance of matching write strength to token state within each role.
blocks.zh: 角色内部的洗牌比角色的副作用更有害(图4 a). 对于蒙面姿势,摇摆使CE增加了0.1320.132,而平均比0.0680.068低;对于可见姿势,相应增加0.2940.294和0.1240.1240.124. 接受交换保留了原始的书写优势,但将其指定给同一角色的不同符号. 在这个分布式保存交换下CE的增加确立了在每个角色内将写强度与符号状态相匹配的功能重要性.

blocks.en: Single-block interventions locate this token–volume dependence through depth (Figure 4 b). In the first block, replacing visible-token volume increases CE by + 0.0673 +0.0673 , while replacing masked-token volume has an effect of only + 0.0015 +0.0015 . Visible-token sensitivity peaks in the first block; masked-token sensitivity peaks near the readout.
blocks.zh: 单块干预措施通过深度确定这种象征性依赖(图4b)。 在第一个区块中,替换显式托肯体积增加CE为+0.0673+0.0673,而替换蒙式托肯体积的作用只有+0.015+0.0015. 显式托肯体积在第一个区块中的灵敏度峰;蒙式托肯体积在读取器附近.

blocks.en:
These interventions show that denoising depends most on visible-token write volume early and masked-token write volume late. Since volume scales the branch update, this depth profile links early evidence integration to later prediction refinement within a single denoising pass. The zero visible effect in the final block follows from the absence of subsequent attention. Across interior blocks, visible-token sensitivity declines sharply after the first block, while masked-token sensitivity follows a non-monotonic profile that peaks near the readout. Token-specific volume assignment and the early-visible / late-masked endpoint contrast also recur
at 1B (Appendix I.3 ).
blocks.zh:
这些干预措施表明,消音主要取决于早期可见脚本写字量和晚期蒙面脚本写字量。 由于量度尺度化分支更新,这种深度剖面将早期证据集成与日后的预测完善在单一的解析通道内联系起来. 最终块中的零可见效应源于后续关注的缺失. 在整个内部块中,可见孔的敏感度在第一个块后急剧下降,而遮盖孔的敏感度则跟随一个接近读出时达到顶峰的非摩诺特征. 特定托肯量分配和早期可见/后期的端点对比也重复出现
1B(附录一.3)。

blocks.en: Finally, we test how the importance of token-specific volume changes with corruption level (Figure 4 c). Replacing volume with role means increases CE by 0.177 0.177 – 0.201 0.201 at 10–50% masking, but by only 0.067 0.067 at 90% masking, when few visible tokens remain. The largest measured CE cost thus occurs with substantial visible context. Together with the depth interventions, this points to a role for write volume in regulating how the model uses observed evidence to predict missing content.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Our findings show that residual architecture shapes both model quality and how diffusion language models preserve evidence and refine predictions. Multiple persistent states retain useful early information while others evolve, and learned routing returns it to active computation later. This links visible and masked token roles to information processing through depth. We hope this work encourages closer study of residual architectures and pathways tailored to denoising, making when information is retained, updated, and reused an explicit consideration in diffusion-model design.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,残余建筑既塑造了模型质量,也塑造了传播语言模型如何保存证据和完善预测. 多种持久性状态保留了有用的早期信息,而其他的则在进化,所学的路由在后来恢复到主动计算. 这把可见和蒙蔽的象征角色与信息处理通过深度联系起来. 我们希望这项工作鼓励更密切地研究残余建筑和适合打点的路径,在保留、更新和重新利用信息时,明确考虑推广模式的设计。

blocks.en: Both scales use the proportional reconstruction and acceptance rules in Appendix A . Role-mean replacements are applied at feasible positions, while within-role shuffling uses mutually feasible pair exchanges. These interventions preserve each affected token’s normalized write destination and keep gains in [ 0 , 2 ] [0,2] ; pair exchanges also preserve the complete volume multiset within each sequence, role, and interface. Full-network acceptance coverage for both scales is reported in Table 2 ; coverage for the 1B single-block endpoint interventions appears in Table 14 .
